arStrings.szText: "Seems like we will need the help of your friend, Queen Adreona. How close were the two of you, really?"
More than friends, but nothing to gossip about.
A little uncomfortable talking about a romantic relationship he used to have.
Years ago, I traveled to Skovos with Tyrael and Donan. We were searching for a lost expedition of Horadrim, but we got wrapped up in the local politics. That’s when I met Adreona.
Rather than getting into specifics of his romantic relationship, Lorath talks about the context surrounding it.
There was a spark, yes. But I was Horadrim. She was to be queen. A life together just wasn’t in the stars.
Hint of regret, but he's trying to shrug it off.
